description: Singapore government open data: NEA weather and air quality, PUB flood alerts, carparks, cameras, public holidays and hawker closures from data.gov.sg, and bus, MRT and traffic from LTA DataMall.

agents.description: Singapore now: weather, rain and the rain radar (where rain is, how it moved over the last hours and where it is heading for a location or shared pin), haze/PSI, UV and heat; flood and lightning alerts; live bus arrivals and bus stops; MRT/LRT service status; traffic incidents; carpark lots and free or night parking; speed and red-light cameras; public holidays; hawker centre closures. Brief it with the owner's region (north, south, east, west or central) and any saved bus stop codes, carparks or favourite hawker centres.
